**Verdict:** valid, open follow-on design ticket; not handled or superseded. This is not a runtime bug or code-fix task.

**Scope:** settle the v1 semantic element set and authoring syntax for website and GUI concepts, including which application concepts belong in v1. Preserve the parent’s invariants (raw HTML/CSS remains an escape hatch, semantic meaning/accessibility, and state/action binding). Close with the chosen shape, rejected alternatives, and implementation invariants as the issue requests.

**Boundary:** do not absorb style tokens (#5850), web/native/custom target mappings (#5851–#5853), per-target customization (#5854), or rendering pipeline/conformance (#5855). Do not silently fork #5679; record any material conflict there.

**Ordering / blockers:** #5849 and #5850 are the first-tier vocabulary designs and can proceed in parallel. #5851–#5853 follow the settled vocabularies; #5854 follows the target mappings; #5855 follows settled rendering behavior. No code or human blocker prevents this design work; treat the still-open #5679 model as a constraint and record assumptions/conflicts explicitly.
